<style>
  .video-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .video-wrapper video {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  /* Optional: overlay content */
  .overlay-content {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    color: white;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 2em;
  }
</style>
